description: Simplified single-effect NH3-H2O absorption chiller cycle
assumptions: Complete condensation of refrigerant vapor to liquid

notes.generator: Weak solution at bubble point at P_high; vapor in equilibrium at same T and P
notes.absorber: Strong solution at bubble point at P_low
notes.condenser: Complete condensation: liquid composition equals vapor composition y_ref; bubble-point temperature at P_high
notes.evaporator: Complete evaporation: vapor at dew-point temperature at P_low with composition y_ref
notes.circulation_ratio: Mass-based: f = (w_ref - w_weak) / (w_strong - w_weak) where w = mass fractions
notes.Q_generator: h_V_ref + (f - 1) * h_L_weak - f * h_L_strong, per unit refrigerant mass flow
notes.Q_evaporator: h_V_evap - h_L_cond, per unit refrigerant mass flow
